tiers.text: Every player gains 2 credits each round for the rest of the game.
Every player gains 3 credits each round for the rest of the game.
Every player gains 3 credits each round for the rest of the game, and 2 ambassadors now.
The next 2 cards any player keeps from the draft are free.
The next 3 cards any player keeps from the draft are free, and every player gains 1 ambassador.
The next 4 cards any player keeps from the draft are free, and every player gains 2 ambassadors.
Every player gains 1 insight each round for the rest of the game.
Every player gains 1 insight each round for the rest of the game, and 1 ambassador now.
Every player gains 1 insight each round for the rest of the game; one player removes up to 6 agents on or next to one corrupted city in their reach, then gains 2 ambassadors.
Counter an active threat.
Counter an active threat; one player removes 2 agents in one hex in their reach.
Counter every active threat; one player removes up to 6 agents on or next to one corrupted city in their reach.
In each country, remove 1 agent, and a neutral research station opens on its lowest-numbered empty station site.
In each country, remove 2 agents, and a neutral research station opens on its lowest-numbered empty station site.
In each country, remove 3 agents, and a neutral research station opens on its lowest-numbered empty station site.
Sway 3 toward Unity.
Sway 3 toward Unity, and every player gains 1 ambassador.
One player gains 8 ambassadors.
Counter an active threat, and every player gains 2 credits.
Counter every active threat.
Counter every active threat; one player removes up to 3 troops in their reach.
Every player gains 5 credits now.
Every player gains 4 credits now, and 2 credits each round for the rest of the game.
Every player gains 6 credits now, and 3 credits each round for the rest of the game.
Remove a botnet anywhere on the board.
Remove 2 botnets anywhere on the board.
Remove 2 botnets anywhere on the board; one player removes up to 3 troops in their reach.
One player removes up to 2 troops in their reach.
One player removes up to 4 troops in their reach.
One player removes up to 6 troops in their reach.
One player removes up to 2 agents on or next to one corrupted city in their reach.
One player removes up to 4 agents on or next to one corrupted city in their reach.
One player removes up to 6 agents on or next to one corrupted city in their reach, then gains 2 ambassadors.
Every player gains 1 ambassador.
Every player gains 2 ambassadors.
One player gains 6 ambassadors and moves up to 3 of their ambassadors onto pieces in their reach.
One player takes the adversary cube off a corrupted research station or factory in their reach.
One player takes the adversary cube off up to 2 corrupted research stations or factories in their reach.
One player takes the adversary cube off up to 2 corrupted research stations or factories in their reach, then removes up to 6 agents on or next to one corrupted city in their reach.
Every player gains 1 energy.
Every player gains 2 energy.
Every player gains 2 energy; one player removes up to 6 agents on or next to one corrupted city in their reach.
One player removes 2 agents or 2 troops in one hex in their reach.
One player removes 3 agents or 3 troops in one hex in their reach.
One player removes 4 agents or 4 troops in one hex in their reach, then up to 6 agents on or next to one corrupted city in their reach.
One player removes a botnet in their reach.
One player removes a botnet in their reach, and clears a corruption marker in their reach.
One player removes a botnet in their reach, clears up to 2 corruption markers in their reach, then removes up to 6 agents on or next to one corrupted city in their reach.
Sway 2 toward Unity, and every player gains 2 credits.
Sway 4 toward Unity.
Sway 3 toward Unity; one player gains 6 ambassadors.
Every player gains 4 credits.
Every player gains 5 credits and 1 ambassador.
Every player gains 5 credits and 3 ambassadors.
One player gains 1 ambassador and moves up to 2 of their ambassadors onto pieces in their reach.
One player gains 2 ambassadors and moves up to 3 of their ambassadors onto pieces in their reach.
One player gains 4 ambassadors and moves up to 4 of their ambassadors onto pieces in their reach.
One player removes up to 2 agents in their reach.
One player removes up to 4 agents in their reach.
One player removes up to 6 agents in their reach, swaying 1 toward Unity for every 2.
Deal 1 extra threat.
Deal 2 extra threats, and one tier-2 threat in each country.
Deal 3 extra threats, and two tier-2 threats in each country.
Each board: create 1 agent on the lowest-numbered city holding agents, and a neutral factory opens on its lowest-numbered free industrial zone.
Each board: create 2 agents on the lowest-numbered city holding agents, and a neutral factory opens on its lowest-numbered free industrial zone; then Corrupt cities.
Each board: create 3 agents on the lowest-numbered city holding agents, and a neutral factory opens on its lowest-numbered free industrial zone; then Corrupt cities.
Every player loses 4 credits; remove 2 Unity from the Unity track.
Every player loses 6 credits and 1 ambassador; remove 3 Unity from the Unity track.
Every player loses 8 credits and 2 ambassadors; remove 4 Unity from the Unity track.
Corrupt cities, then deal a tier-2 threat with its token on the node hex with the most agents and troops.
Corrupt cities, then deal two tier-2 threats with their tokens on the node hex with the most agents and troops.
The adversary builds, then Corrupt cities and deal two tier-2 threats with their tokens on the node hex with the most agents and troops.
Deal 2 extra threats.
Deal two tier-2 threats in each country.
Deal 3 extra threats, and two tier-2 threats in each country.
Each board: create 2 agents on the lowest-numbered city holding agents.
Each board: create 2 agents on the lowest-numbered city holding agents, then Corrupt cities.
Each board: create 3 agents on the lowest-numbered city holding agents, then Corrupt cities (1 fewer).
